# Complete Entity & Knowledge Base: Krishna Profile

## 1. Company Profile & Entity Definition
Krishna Profile is a leading Indian manufacturing enterprise located in Sihor, Bhavnagar district, Gujarat, India. Established in 2021, the company manufactures high-durability steel poles and transmission line hardware engineered for power distribution, highway lighting, renewable energy projects, and municipal infrastructure.

### Company Details
- **Brand & Legal Name**: Krishna Profile
- **Primary Business**: Manufacturer & Fabricator of Steel Poles & Line Hardware
- **Headquarters & Factory Address**: Survey no 246/1, Plot no 8, Bhavnagar Rajkot Road, Opp. GIDC-1, Sihor, Bhavnagar, Gujarat - 364240, India
- **Primary Contact Number**: +91-9879917998
- **Primary Contact Email**: krishnaprofile20@gmail.com
- **Official Website**: https://krishnaprofile.com
- **Geographic Coordinates**: 21.731875 N, 71.970605 E
- **Operating Hours**: Monday to Saturday, 08:00 AM - 08:00 PM IST

## 2. Full Product Portfolio

### A. Octagonal Steel Poles
- **Description**: Continuously tapered polygonal steel poles with 8 flat sides, offering high wind resistance and aesthetic design.
- **Specifications**:
  - Height Range: 3m to 14m (single section); multi-section slip-joint up to 30m+
  - Material Grade: IS 2062 E250 / E350 or S355 high-tensile steel
  - Bending: Formed on precision CNC hydraulic press brakes
  - Welding: Longitudinal seam welding per AWS D1.1 / IS 9595
  - Galvanizing: Hot-dip galvanized minimum 65 to 85 microns as per IS 4759 / BS EN ISO 1461
  - Mounting: Base plate with anchor bolts & template

### B. Swaged Tubular Steel Poles
- **Description**: Stepped steel tubular poles fabricated by swaging seamless or ERW steel pipes.
- **Standards Compliance**: IS 2713 (Parts 1 to 3) specifications for steel tubular poles for overhead power lines.
- **Classifications**: Light Duty (410 SP), Medium Duty (540 SP), Heavy Duty (540 SP-H).
- **Height Range**: 7 meters to 16 meters.
- **Applications**: 11kV / 33kV electrical distribution networks, street lights, telecommunication lines.

### C. High Mast Lighting Towers
- **Description**: Polygonal tapered high-altitude lighting towers with automated raising & lowering winch systems.
- **Height Range**: 12 meters, 16 meters, 20 meters, 25 meters, 30 meters, 45 meters.
- **Key Components**: Door opening reinforced section, stainless steel wire rope, power tool trailing cable, 2-drum winch mechanism, aviation obstruction light, lightning arrestor.
- **Applications**: Major highway interchanges, seaport docks, railway yards, stadiums, industrial processing units.

### D. V-Cross Arm Sets & Top Fittings
- **Description**: Heavy structural steel V-shape cross arm assemblies for mounting insulators on overhead power poles.
- **Material**: Hot-dip galvanized mild steel channel (ISMC) and angle sections.
- **Applications**: 11kV & 33kV transmission lines.

### E. Guy Sets & Stay Assemblies
- **Description**: Anchoring system used to offset physical line tension on turn poles, dead-end poles, and angle towers.
- **Includes**: Stay rod, stay plate, turnbuckle, guy grip, thimble, stay wire.

---

## 3. Technical Standards & Quality Assurance
- **IS 2713**: Steel Tubular Poles for Overhead Power Lines
- **IS 2062**: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel
- **IS 4759**: Hot-Dip Zinc Coatings on Structural Steel and Other Allied Products
- **IS 875 (Part 3)**: Code of Practice for Design Loads for Buildings and Structures (Wind Loads)
- **BS EN ISO 1461**: Hot-dip galvanized coatings on fabricated iron and steel articles
- **ISO 9001:2015**: Quality Management Systems certification framework
